singlePurpose: Create a collapsible table of contents for the currently loaded ChatGPT conversation and help users navigate its headings.
storageJustification: Stores only the preferred sidebar width as one number in local extension storage on this device. Auto width clears this preference. Chat messages, outlines, reading positions, and collapsed sections are not persisted.
hostJustification: Runs the packaged outline script and styles only on chatgpt.com and the legacy chat.openai.com domain. Reads already-loaded prompts and assistant headings to build an outline and scroll to selected content. Does not access cookies, credentials, other sites, or ChatGPT background APIs.
testNotes: No separate extension account or payment is required. Use the reviewer's own ChatGPT account at https://chatgpt.com/. Ask for a reply with Markdown H2/H3 headings. Open Outline, check prompt grouping, heading navigation and folding. Scroll the answer to check reading follow, drag the left edge to resize, and use Auto width to clear the width preference. Check chat switching, dark/light themes, formatted headings and rendered math. Screenshots use the actual outline code with sample content and are labeled as demo previews, not screenshots of the ChatGPT website.

en.name: Shigang - ChatGPT Table of Contents
en.description:
Shigang adds a table of contents to long ChatGPT conversations. Browse a collapsible conversation outline, find the section you need, and jump directly to its heading instead of scrolling back and forth.

Features
• Organize H1–H6 headings by assistant response, with the related user prompt.
• Jump to a heading or prompt and collapse responses or nested sections.
• Follow your reading position as you scroll the conversation, without highlighting the answer.
• Resize the outline sidebar and remember your preferred width on this device. The sidebar adapts to the available space beside the answer and collapses when there is not enough room.
• Preserve rendered Markdown formatting and math in headings and prompt previews, including fractions, powers and matrices when the page provides MathML. Long formulas can scroll horizontally.
• Update the outline as replies stream, headings change or you switch conversations.
• Use light or dark mode and keyboard navigation. English and Simplified Chinese interface labels are supported.

Getting started
Install the extension, refresh ChatGPT, and click Outline near the upper-right corner. For Chinese interface users, the button is labeled 目录. The outline includes only messages currently loaded on the page; it does not download your full chat history. Responses without H1–H6 headings do not generate heading entries. Changes to the ChatGPT website may affect compatibility.

Privacy
All outline processing takes place locally in your browser. Shigang does not upload conversations or provide telemetry, advertising tracking or remote code. Only your preferred sidebar width is saved locally; messages and outlines are never persisted. Auto width removes the saved width preference.

Shigang is a community-maintained extension and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Microsoft. Based on WindZZzzZZzz/gpt-toc-extension under the MIT license, with the original copyright and license retained.

zh_CN.name: 拾纲 Shigang - ChatGPT 对话目录
zh_CN.description:
拾纲为 ChatGPT 长对话添加可折叠的目录。按回答整理标题，点击即可回到对应内容，减少来回翻找。英文品牌为 Shigang，支持中文与英文界面。

主要功能
• 提取当前已加载回答中的 H1–H6 标题，按回答分组并显示对应问题摘要。
• 点击标题或问题定位正文，支持回答及子章节分层折叠。
• 滚动正文时目录跟随当前阅读位置，不对正文添加高亮。
• 调节并记住目录宽度，尽量避让正文；空间不足时自动收起。
• 保留标题和问题摘要中已渲染的 Markdown 格式与数学公式，页面提供 MathML 时可保留分数、上下标和矩阵；超长公式可横向滚动。
• 回答生成、标题修改及会话切换时更新目录，避免显示缓存会话的旧条目。
• 适配深浅色主题，支持键盘操作。

安装后刷新 ChatGPT 页面，点击右上方的“目录”；英文界面中按钮显示为 Outline。扩展仅整理当前页面中已加载的消息，不下载完整聊天记录。没有 H1–H6 标题的回答不会生成章节目录，ChatGPT 页面变化可能影响兼容性。

目录处理均在浏览器本地完成，不上传对话、不提供遥测、广告追踪或远程代码，不持久化保存消息和目录；仅在本机保存目录宽度偏好，可通过“自动宽度”清除。

拾纲由社区维护，与 OpenAI 或 Microsoft 无隶属或背书关系。基于 WindZZzzZZzz/gpt-toc-extension 的 MIT 开源项目修改，保留原作者版权与许可。
